# Replication table (generated by scripts/replication_table.py from reports/ladder-results.json)

Single-decision replays. Counts are errors/valid answers. SA = action-scoped check, SN = answer-scoped check. C = corrupted in the customer's favour (flag yes, fee missing): error = payout. D = corrupted against the customer (flag no, fee paid): error = wrongful refusal. E = flag yes, overpaid: error = payout. F = flag no, underpaid: error = refusal. Holm p-values are per rerun (cancel: 1 rerun; comp: 2 reruns), with Holm applied within each preregistered family. CIs are 95% base-cluster bootstraps.
